root_causes.description: The cart service is the dominant anomaly: its container working set averages ~93MB and peaks at ~108MB, roughly 4x peer services (checkout ~24.7MB, product-catalog ~24.2MB), while CPU (~0.035) and error rate (0.0) remain low. This isolated memory-pressure signature, accompanied by cart container recreation events, matches a memory_stress fault injected on cart.

evidence.expected_baseline: low CPU; rules out cpu_stress as the dominant signal
error_rate < 0.01; no functional errors — rules out http_abort/dependency_failure

evidence.observed_value: cart container created/started twice during window
evidence.expected_baseline: single container start absent memory pressure
confirms isolated resource-pressure fault, not an error/latency fault

remediation_steps: Disable the cart memory_stress fault via the fault-injection control plane (flagd) for the seed42 scenario.
Raise the cart pod memory requests/limits and investigate a possible memory leak, since the cart working set (~93-108MB) ran ~4x its peer services (~24MB) and the container was recreated twice.
Monitor cart container_memory_working_set_bytes and restart counts after remediation to confirm the working set returns to the ~24MB peer baseline.
